scenario_enrichment.summary: Added source-safe scenario classifying occupied-building support as SPP 205 post-construction services rather than construction-phase inspection.
scenario_enrichment.scenario_excerpt: After turnover, a mixed-use building owner asks an architect to help the property team handle recurring complaints about corridor cleanliness, parking circulation, landscape upkeep, equipment maintenance, and tenant billing coordination. Under the checked SPP 205 sources, the safer classification is post-construction building and facilities administration, not construction-phase inspection. The architect can help keep communication channels open and coordinate building maintenance, grounds and landscaping, equipment maintenance through proper third parties, and business or occupancy support, while defect-focused review stays in post-construction evaluation when the owner requests it.
